subject.title: chatCompletions: ignore request model when x-openclaw-agent-id header is present

question: Should a valid x-openclaw-agent-id header make /v1/chat/completions ignore a non-OpenClaw request-body model, even though the current public contract treats model as an OpenClaw agent target?
rationale: The code change is bounded, but it changes a stable documented Gateway HTTP API contract and likely needs sibling endpoint alignment rather than a chat-only bypass.

options.title: Accept header precedence
options.body: Let a valid agent-id header own agent selection and treat a generic body model as SDK noise when no x-openclaw-model override is present, with docs and tests updated across compatible endpoints.

options.title: Keep strict agent-first model
options.body: Continue requiring OpenClaw agent-target model ids and document the OpenAI SDK workaround more directly for clients that always send provider model names.

options.title: Add explicit compatibility mode
options.body: Preserve strict default behavior and add a narrow documented opt-in only if maintainers want SDK compatibility without changing current callers.

recommendation.title: Accept header precedence
recommendation.body: Let a valid agent-id header own agent selection and treat a generic body model as SDK noise when no x-openclaw-model override is present, with docs and tests updated across compatible endpoints.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant product contract was introduced in the agent-first Gateway HTTP change attributed to this person in history.
